statements.t: We remain on track to achieve the near-term milestone of reporting the interim analysis results from the Phase 2b PLATEAU clinical trial in the first quarter of calendar year 2027.”
During the past quarter, the Company exceeded its Phase 2b PLATEAU clinical trial targeted full enrollment of 200 patients by enrolling 239 patients.
The audio webcast will be accessible under the Home page and Investors page of the Company’s website at www.verupharma.com.
An archived version of the audio webcast will be available for replay on the Company’s website for approximately three months.
